source.based_on: Current Android CcpMonths.kt and CcpYears.kt logic
source.important: This helper is active remote dosing data. Validate every update before publishing, and increase version/schema_version when the helper content or contract changes.
source.schema_versioning: schema_version is a string. Increase it as 0.2, 0.3, etc. when the helper contract changes.

app_support_contract.goal: Allow medication, indication, route, note, dose-factor, caps, availability, and supported UI changes without a new app release.
may_need_app_update: new dose rule type not listed in supported_rule_types
new input type other than age months, age years, or direct weight kg
new UI interaction beyond viewing sections and calculating supported dose rules
new icon rendering system if icon_key is not mapped by the app
new visual component type outside medication cards, warning cards, chips, and section rows
new concentration calculation mode outside user-entered amount and volume
rendering_rules: Sections with enabled=false are hidden.
Medications with enabled=false are hidden.
Unknown fields must be ignored by the app.
Unknown dose rule types must not be calculated; show a safe unsupported-rule message instead.
Dose display should be generated by the app from dose_rule when possible.
If dose_rule.display_override is present, it may be shown directly after validation.
Medication ui colors are optional; the app must fall back to app theme colors if missing or invalid.
Section ui colors are optional and override medication ui only for that section.
Text and background colors must be validated for contrast by the app before rendering.
Medication concentration guide is educational only until the user confirms or enters the concentration used for volume calculation.
Search aliases and keywords are optional and should never affect dose calculations.
Section-level blocking must be represented as a conditional dose_rule override to not_indicated; do not use blocked_when.
A conditional dose_rule always uses default first, then replaces it with the first matching override rule.
age_or_weight_tier rules should use weight_tiers when the user entered direct weight, and age_tiers when the user entered age/estimated weight.
If an age_or_weight_tier rule has a block condition that matches, show the not-indicated reason and do not calculate a dose.
For age_or_weight_tier rules, tiers are evaluated in listed order and the first matching tier is used.
A medication is visible only when medication.enabled=true and availability.enabled is not false.
A disabled medication may stay in the helper for future reactivation and must not appear in the app UI/search.
If a medication is removed from the helper, the app must remove it from the displayed medication list after the helper refreshes.
A section is visible only when section.enabled=true and the current profile is included in section.applies_to.
Deleted sections disappear after helper refresh; disabled sections remain available for future reactivation but must be hidden.

direct_weight_kg.max_warning: The weight entered exceeds the estimated weight for a 12-month-old child.

excluded_tools.name: WAAFELSS
excluded_tools.reason: WAAFELSS is a calculation tool, not a medication dosing helper entry.

review_flags: Hydrocortison spelling is preserved from current Android UI; consider clinical/display correction to Hydrocortisone.
Some current Android notes contain legacy spacing/wording; this helper preserves the reviewed wording and normalizes only minimal punctuation.
Some rules are clinically represented with caps even when the current code only notes MAX in text; verify expected display against current app before wiring.
Static-range is listed in data and should be implemented by the app if this helper is wired.
Conditional route_when_calculated and notes_when_not_indicated must be supported before using conditional RSI/paralytic sections.
This JSON intentionally does not include AP medications.
Schema version 2 adds UI/display/search/concentration/warning metadata; Android code is not wired to consume it yet.
Medication colors are production UI metadata and should still be reviewed visually after future palette changes.
The app should validate remote colors for contrast and fall back to the app theme when invalid.
Concentration guide values are package/preparation guides only; users must confirm the actual concentration used for volume calculation.
Medications with concentration.mode=not_required do not show the concentration card or concentration-based volume calculator.
Ketamine blocked_when entries were normalized into conditional dose_rule overrides using not_indicated rules.
static_range is now listed as a supported rule type because Salbutamol/Ipratropium-style dose ranges use it.
Hydrocortisone Adrenal Crisis and Ibuprofen use age_or_weight_tier rules; app implementation must support direct-weight tiers separately from age tiers.
Ibuprofen is marked concentration.mode=not_required because it is PO/oral in this helper and does not use draw-up volume calculation.
Normalized exact age conditions to age_years_min/age_years_max instead of age_years for parser consistency.
schema_version changed to string "0.1" so future helper contract revisions can be increased as "0.2", "0.3", etc.
Disabled medications should stay in the helper when they may be reactivated later; deleting the medication object removes it completely after helper refresh.
Droperidol is intentionally kept in the helper with enabled=false and availability.enabled=false.
Ibuprofen includes a 12-month CCP Months age tier mapping to the 1-year 50 mg dose because it is not for use under 1 year old.

default_result_format.calculation_basis_template: Dose and volume are based on {weight_kg} kg and concentration {concentration_label}.

warning.title: Check concentration before drawing volume
warning.message: The volume changes if the medication is diluted or prepared differently. Confirm the concentration used for this dose.

deprecated_section_fields.replacement: dose_rule.type=conditional with an override rule of type=not_indicated
deprecated_section_fields.reason: Keeps age/weight/profile exceptions in one rule engine path.

conditional_rule_contract.evaluation: Use default rule unless an override condition matches. If multiple overrides match, use the first matching override in array order.

age_or_weight_tier_rule_contract.selection: Use weight_tiers when direct weight was entered. Use age_tiers when age was entered and weight was estimated from age.
age_or_weight_tier_rule_contract.block_when: Optional list of profile/age/weight conditions that return a not-indicated reason before tiers are evaluated.
age_or_weight_tier_rule_contract.tie_behavior: Direct entered weight is treated as more specific than age-estimated weight.

schema_version_history.summary: Initial active remote CCP pediatric dosing helper contract with medication metadata, UI metadata, concentration behavior, conditional rules, age/weight tier rules, and disabled-item lifecycle rules.

medication_lifecycle_contract.enabled_true: Medication can be shown if availability also allows the current profile/scope.
medication_lifecycle_contract.enabled_false: Medication remains in the helper for review or future reactivation but must be hidden from app medication lists, search, and calculators.
medication_lifecycle_contract.deleted_from_helper: Medication should disappear completely from the app after the helper is refreshed. Cached copies should be replaced by the latest valid helper.
medication_lifecycle_contract.availability_enabled_false: Also hides the medication. Use this together with enabled=false to make review intent obvious.
medication_lifecycle_contract.section_enabled_false: Section remains in the helper but must be hidden from the medication result sheet.
medication_lifecycle_contract.unknown_rule_type: Do not calculate. Show a safe unsupported-rule message.

editor_guide.show_medication_again: Set both medication.enabled=true and medication.availability.enabled=true after reviewing all sections.
editor_guide.remove_medication_completely: Delete the medication object from the medications array.
editor_guide.add_indication: Add a new object to medication.sections using the same required section fields and a supported dose_rule type.

choose_rule_type.weight_based_single: Dose = weight x factor, optionally with min/max caps.
choose_rule_type.weight_based_range: Dose range = weight x min_factor to weight x max_factor.
choose_rule_type.weight_based_with_min_max: Weight based dose with both minimum and maximum dose limits.
choose_rule_type.weight_based_rate_single: Weight based rate such as mcg/kg/min.
choose_rule_type.weight_based_rate_range: Weight based rate range such as 0.05-0.3 mcg/kg/min.
choose_rule_type.conditional: Use default rule unless a profile/age/weight override matches.
choose_rule_type.age_or_weight_tier: Use fixed age bands or fixed weight bands instead of mg/kg calculation.

volume_calculation.user_entered: Use for medications where dose amount must be converted to volume using a confirmed concentration.
volume_calculation.not_required: Use when dose is already a volume, PO/oral, nebulized/prepared dose, or no draw-up volume should be calculated.
